source.title: Call for Applicants - WQAC Members (July 2023)
source.content:
The WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! Applications are open to everyone and community members not currently holding a WCA position can apply.

**What does the WQAC do?**
The WQAC is responsible for developing and ensuring quality standards within the WCA. This includes producing educational material for the WCA Community, new Delegates, and ensuring that Staff Members throughout the organization maintain the required skills for their positions.

The official rights and duties of the WQAC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2021.8](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.8%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf).
<!-- break-->
**Applicants are expected to have:**

*  Fluency in English
*  Strong attention to detail and practical thinking
*  Collaboration skills and responsiveness
*  Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas
*  Good knowledge of how competitions are organized and run
*  (Desirable) Understanding of the Delegate role
*  (Desirable) Knowledge of Github and Markdown

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until **August 1st, 2023, 23:59 UTC** to Daniel Vædele Egdal ([degdal@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:degdal@worldcubeassociation.org)).

**The application document must be in PDF format, and should include the following:**

* A brief personal introduction
* Summary of activities done within the WCA
* Explanation of how you qualify for the position
* Motivation for applying to join the WQAC

Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact Daniel Vædele Egdal ([degdal@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:degdal@worldcubeassociation.org)).

Thank you for your interest in assisting the WQAC and the WCA!

translation.title: WCA 质量保证委员会成员招募（2023 年 7 月）
translation.content:
WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）正在招募新成员，一起完成委员会的工作！申请面向所有人，目前未在 WCA 担任职务的社区成员也可以申请。

**WQAC 负责什么？**

WQAC 负责制定并落实 WCA 内部的质量标准，包括为 WCA 社区和新代表制作教学材料，以及确保协会各部门的工作人员具备其岗位所需的技能。

WQAC 的正式权利与职责载于 [WCA 动议 10.2021.8](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.8%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf)。

**申请人应具备以下条件：**

* 英语流利
* 注重细节，思考务实
* 善于合作，能够及时回应
* 能够讨论想法并说明理由
* 熟悉比赛的组织和运行方式
* 了解代表的职责者优先
* 熟悉 GitHub 和 Markdown 者优先

申请时间为即日起至 **2023 年 8 月 1 日 23:59 UTC**，请将申请材料发送给 Daniel Vædele Egdal（[degdal@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:degdal@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，应包含：**

* 简短的个人介绍
* 在 WCA 内参与工作的概述
* 自己符合岗位要求的理由
* 申请加入 WQAC 的原因

我们会回复确认收到申请，之后可能邀请申请人面谈。如有申请方面的疑问，可联系 Daniel Vædele Egdal（[degdal@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:degdal@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

感谢你愿意帮助 WQAC 和 WCA！
